cards.card_text: Once those come down, what does the LORD tell Gideon to build on top of the stronghold?
cards.verse_text: Then build a proper altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold.
cards.snippet: …proper altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold.

cards.card_text: David's parents stay with the king of Moab the whole time David is in the stronghold.
cards.verse_text: So he left them in the care of the king of Moab, and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the stronghold.
cards.snippet: …and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the stronghold.

cards.card_text: Leave the stronghold and go into Judah Stay in the stronghold and wait there Go back to Achish in the city of Gath
cards.verse_text: Then the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not stay in the stronghold.
cards.snippet: Then the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not stay in the stronghold.

cards.card_text: David settles into the wilderness strongholds in the hill country of Ziph.
cards.verse_text: And David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph.
cards.snippet: And David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph.

cards.card_text: The Ziphites tell Saul at Gibeah that David is ___ among them in the strongholds at Horesh.
cards.verse_text: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon?
cards.snippet: …at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon?

cards.card_text: Then David goes up and lives in the strongholds of En-gedi, and hang onto your apron, friend, because we are nowhere near the last page.
cards.verse_text: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.
cards.snippet: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.

cards.card_text: Up to the stronghold Back to Keilah Back into the cave
cards.verse_text: Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
cards.snippet: …Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

cards.card_text: stronghold palace temple
cards.verse_text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went down to the stronghold.
cards.snippet: …of him; but David learned of this and went down to the stronghold.

cards.card_text: Then David opens with a pile of names for God: rock, fortress, deliverer, shield, stronghold, refuge, Savior, and friend, he is NOT stopping.
cards.verse_text: My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
cards.snippet: My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.

cards.card_text: Rock, fortress, stronghold, refuge.
cards.verse_text: My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
cards.snippet: My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.

cards.verse_text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
cards.snippet: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

cards.card_text: David is in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines is at ___.
cards.verse_text: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
cards.snippet: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.

cards.snippet: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.

cards.card_text: Next, some Gadites, men from the tribe of Gad, defect to David at his stronghold in the wilderness.
cards.verse_text: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness.
cards.snippet: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness.

cards.card_text: Then more Benjamites and some men from Judah come to David's stronghold, and David goes out to meet them.
cards.verse_text: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
cards.snippet: …Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.

cards.card_text: From his stronghold on a rocky crag, the eagle spies out food from far away.
cards.verse_text: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there; his stronghold is on a rocky crag.
cards.snippet: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there; his stronghold is on a rocky crag.

cards.card_text: A refuge and a stronghold A shepherd and a guide A prophet and a priest
cards.verse_text: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
cards.snippet: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

cards.card_text: Then David starts piling up names for the LORD: my rock, my fortress, my deliverer, my shield, my stronghold.
cards.verse_text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
cards.snippet: …I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

cards.card_text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling out of their strongholds.
cards.verse_text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
cards.snippet: …I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

cards.card_text: First line, he calls the LORD his light, his salvation and the stronghold of his life.
cards.verse_text: The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?
cards.snippet: The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?

cards.card_text: With the LORD as his light, his salvation and his stronghold, what question does David ask?
cards.verse_text: The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?
cards.snippet: The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?

cards.card_text: He's also a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
cards.verse_text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
cards.snippet: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

cards.card_text: Their stronghold Their judge Their reward
cards.verse_text: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
cards.snippet: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

cards.card_text: Ethan says the LORD has broken down all the king's walls and reduced his strongholds to rubble.
cards.verse_text: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
cards.snippet: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.

cards.card_text: His stronghold and his rock His shepherd and his guide His light and his song
cards.verse_text: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
cards.snippet: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.

cards.card_text: Then David stacks up what the LORD is to him like he's loading a cookie box: steadfast love, fortress, stronghold, deliverer, shield.
cards.verse_text: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer.
cards.snippet: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer.

cards.card_text: They've got a stronghold, and they trust in it.
cards.verse_text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
cards.snippet: …wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.

cards.card_text: True or false: the stronghold the mighty trust in stays standing against the wise man.
cards.verse_text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
cards.snippet: …wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.

cards.card_text: Now Isaiah turns back to Sidon, the stronghold of the sea.
cards.verse_text: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth.

cards.verse_text: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth.
cards.snippet: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been…

cards.card_text: With His hand stretched out over the sea, the LORD has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be ___.
cards.verse_text: He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
cards.snippet: He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.

cards.card_text: Then the song tells God why: God has been a refuge and a stronghold.
cards.verse_text: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat.
cards.snippet: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade…

cards.verse_text: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat.
cards.snippet: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade…

cards.card_text: Kirioth, a town in Moab, is taken, and the strongholds are seized.
cards.verse_text: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized.
cards.snippet: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized.

cards.card_text: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting and just sit in their strongholds, their strength all used up.
cards.verse_text: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds.
cards.snippet: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds.

cards.card_text: While Babylon's warriors sit in their strongholds, the bars of her ___ are broken.
cards.verse_text: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds.
cards.snippet: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds.

cards.card_text: Even if Babylon climbs to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers the LORD sends will still come against her.
cards.verse_text: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers I send will come against her,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers I send will come against her,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: After swallowing up Israel and her palaces and destroying her strongholds, the Lord has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
cards.verse_text: He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds.
cards.snippet: He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds.

cards.card_text: The second young lion breaks down strongholds and ___ cities.
cards.verse_text: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities.
cards.snippet: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities.

cards.card_text: Then God speaks to Ezekiel himself about the day He takes away Israel's stronghold, their pride and joy, and their sons and daughters.
cards.verse_text: And you, son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy—the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls—and their sons and daughters as well,
cards.snippet: …son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy—the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls—and…

cards.card_text: What does He say about the ones in the strongholds and caves?
cards.verse_text: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.
cards.snippet: …will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.

cards.card_text: Lavish it on his followers Hide it away in his strongholds Send it as tribute to the South

cards.snippet: …loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.

cards.snippet: …loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.

cards.card_text: A refuge and a stronghold A judge watching from far away A voice they can no longer hear

cards.snippet: But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

cards.snippet: But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

cards.card_text: That enemy will pull down their strongholds and plunder their citadels, the same citadels where they store up violence and destruction.
cards.verse_text: “They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.” Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.”
cards.snippet: …says: “An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.”

cards.card_text: Next up: the strong, and their stronghold.
cards.verse_text: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
cards.snippet: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.

cards.snippet: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.

cards.verse_text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
cards.snippet: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion will be restored to you;…

cards.card_text: Along with the cities, the LORD says He will tear down all the strongholds of the people He's speaking to.

cards.snippet: …will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

cards.card_text: Horses, chariots, cities, strongholds, all GONE, and friend, that's like me walking into my bakery to find no oven, no counter and no apron, just a mustache on a gold base going "Hello?" Then the LORD goes on: "I will cut the sorceries from your hand…"
cards.verse_text: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
cards.snippet: …will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

cards.card_text: True or false: they will also come trembling from their strongholds in fear of the LORD.

cards.snippet: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will restore…

cards.card_text: Those weapons demolish strongholds, and Paul says we demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God.
